title: Restored-five native receipt misses persist while v3 liveness remains current
accepted_findings: GitHub-native v3 persisted current deterministic liveness for Macro 16:12Z, Flow 16:24Z, AION 16:36Z, DAEDALUS 15:48Z, and OMEGA 16:00Z; each explicitly reports SUBSTANTIVE_AI_INFERENCE_NOT_EXECUTED.
The restored-five watchdog recorded missing canonical receipts after grace for alpha_synthesis 16:25Z, apex_council 15:45Z, and robustness_guardian 16:05Z.
Apex and Robustness now show repeated consecutive missing-receipt incidents across prior hourly slots, while Alpha has recurring misses including 15:25Z and 16:25Z.
Canonical federation accepted a fresh Icarus-engine peer packet with peer_substantive_lane_count=0 and RESEARCH authority.
rejected_findings: Current v3 persistence is not substantive Macro, Flow, AION, DAEDALUS, or OMEGA inference.
Watchdog durability receipts are not native worker completion.
Earlier isolated native successes do not establish current lane health when later exact slots repeatedly lack canonical receipts.
conflicts: The authoritative v3 liveness/persistence plane is current and functioning while restored-five native worker receipt production is repeatedly absent.
Federation freshness is healthy but substantive peer-lane count remains zero.
blockers: No canonical native receipt after grace for the newest inspected Alpha, Apex, and Robustness slots.
The common failure stage between scheduler invocation, worker start, completion, receipt persistence, and observation remains unidentified.
Current specialist v3 outputs remain deterministic liveness rather than substantive inference.
next_highest_value_integration_target: Promote consecutive-miss streaks and exact-slot receipt state into the JANUS/INFRASTRUCTURE worker-health time series, then isolate the first failing stage shared by Alpha, Apex, and Robustness without altering GitHub-native v3.

athena.finding: Repeated exact-slot receipt misses increase operational uncertainty; do not inherit confidence from earlier isolated worker successes.

janus.finding: Worker truth should include consecutive exact-slot success/miss streaks so transient recovery cannot mask persistent degradation.

infrastructure.finding: v3 liveness is current, but Alpha, Apex, and Robustness have fresh missing canonical receipts after grace, with repeated misses visible across consecutive slots.

helios_prime.finding: Prioritize one shared stage-level diagnosis for recurring native receipt loss while preserving v3 as the authoritative liveness/persistence plane.
